services.title: Home Deep Cleaning
services.short: A healthier and fresher home for you and your family. We clean every corner with care and attention.
services.intro: Our home deep cleaning service is designed to give you a fresh, healthy and spotless living space. We clean every corner with care and attention, removing dust, dirt and allergens to make your home safer and more comfortable for you and your family.
services.checklistIntro: We follow a detailed checklist to ensure your home gets a complete and thorough cleaning.
services.ctaText: Enjoy a cleaner, fresher and healthier home with our professional cleaning services.

services.title: Office Professional Cleaning
services.short: Keep your workplace clean, productive and welcoming with our professional office cleaning services.
services.intro: Our office cleaning service keeps your workplace clean, organised and welcoming. We work around your schedule to clean desks, meeting rooms, kitchens and washrooms, so your team can focus on work in a healthy environment.
services.checklistIntro: We follow a detailed checklist to keep every part of your office fresh and hygienic.
services.ctaText: Give your team a cleaner, healthier and more productive workplace.

services.title: Kitchen Hygiene Cleaning
services.short: We ensure a spotless and germ-free kitchen so you can enjoy a safe and healthy cooking space.
services.intro: Our kitchen hygiene cleaning removes grease, grime and germs from every surface. From cabinets to appliances, we leave your kitchen spotless and safe, so you can cook with complete peace of mind.
services.checklistIntro: We follow a detailed checklist so every corner of your kitchen is clean and germ-free.
services.ctaText: Enjoy a cleaner, safer and healthier kitchen with our hygiene experts.

services.title: Windows Deep Cleaning
services.short: Crystal clear windows for a brighter and more inviting space. We remove dirt, dust and stains effectively.
services.intro: Our windows deep cleaning gives you crystal clear glass inside and out. We remove dirt, dust, water spots and stains from glass, frames and tracks, so more light fills your space.
services.checklistIntro: We follow a detailed checklist to leave every window clean, clear and streak-free.
services.ctaText: Enjoy brighter rooms and a clearer view with our window experts.

services.title: Commercial Building Cleaning
services.short: Complete cleaning solutions for commercial spaces, ensuring a clean, safe and professional environment.
services.intro: Our commercial building cleaning covers lobbies, corridors, offices, washrooms and common areas. Our trained teams use safe products and a clear checklist to keep your building clean, safe and professional every day.
services.checklistIntro: We follow a detailed checklist to keep every floor and common area clean and safe.
services.ctaText: Keep your commercial space clean, safe and professional every day.

services.title: Deep Carpet Cleaning
services.short: Remove deep-seated dirt, allergens and stains with our advanced carpet cleaning methods.
services.intro: Our deep carpet cleaning lifts out dirt, allergens and stains that regular vacuuming leaves behind. We use advanced equipment and safe solutions to refresh your carpets and rugs without damaging the fibres.
services.checklistIntro: We follow a detailed checklist to bring your carpets back to life.
services.ctaText: Enjoy softer, cleaner and healthier carpets with our deep cleaning service.

services.title: Sofa & Upholstery Cleaning
services.short: Restore the freshness, comfort and deep hygiene of your upholstered sofas, cushions and armchairs.
services.intro: Our sofa and upholstery cleaning service removes deep dust, stubborn spots, and allergens to rejuvenate your furniture. We use gentle yet powerful fabric-safe solutions that restore original freshness without damaging texture or colour.
services.checklistIntro: We follow a detailed checklist to carefully clean and revitalize your upholstery.
services.ctaText: Enjoy clean, healthy and revitalized sofas with our upholstery specialists.

services.title: Sanitization & Disinfection
services.short: Hospital-grade sanitization eliminating 99.9% of bacteria and viruses for safe environments.
services.intro: Our sanitization and disinfection service targets high-touch surfaces, shared equipment, and communal zones. Using hospital-grade, eco-friendly disinfectants, we eliminate 99.9% of pathogens to keep your family and workforce safe.
services.checklistIntro: We follow strict hygiene protocols to disinfect and protect every zone.
services.ctaText: Protect your family and employees with certified medical-grade disinfection.

services.title: Move-In & Move-Out Cleaning
services.short: Comprehensive top-to-bottom cleaning ensuring seamless transitions into spotless properties.
services.intro: Moving into a new space or vacating your current one? Our move-in and move-out cleaning service handles all the deep scrubbing, polishing, and sanitizing so you step into a spotless, welcoming environment with complete peace of mind.
services.checklistIntro: We follow an exhaustive checklist to guarantee a 100% spotless handoff.
services.ctaText: Leave the heavy scrubbing to us and focus on settling into your new journey.

processSteps.title: Book a Service
processSteps.text: Choose your service, select a convenient date and time, and book online or via phone in just a few clicks.

processSteps.text: Our trained and verified cleaning team arrives at your location on time with all necessary equipment.

processSteps.title: Cleaning Process
processSteps.text: Our team follows a detailed checklist to deep clean every corner, ensuring a safe, fresh and healthy environment.

processSteps.title: Final Result
processSteps.text: Enjoy a spotless, refreshed space. We ensure your complete satisfaction before we leave.
